explication: Advising App is a student-engagement and relationship-management platform for higher education. Staff work with student and prospect records, identify priority groups, and coordinate conversations, tasks, and guided outreach; students can also submit forms and applications. AI chat and campus-system integrations are documented capabilities. The graph emphasizes these product stages and shared identity, authorization, and notification layers. Several connections reflect README-level capabilities rather than inspected call sites; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
